**The pills are gone.** The Play button on the game details page is now a rectangle with the top-right corner cut away, matching the chamfered poster frames from 1.4.1. The Play half and the streaming selector form a single clipped shape, so the bar reads as one hard-edged control instead of a capsule.

**Focus frames follow the cut.** A clipped box clips outer shadows and real borders, so the Play focus ring is now drawn inside the bar as a frame that turns along the chamfer. The controller-config and Post buttons are chamfered rectangles in the same language, keeping their invert-on-hover behaviour; the Post text box is squared off to match.

**Install / update:** download [`VoidDeck-v1.4.2.zip`](https://github.com/endoflineservice/VoidDeck/releases/download/v1.4.2/VoidDeck-v1.4.2.zip) from the [v1.4.2 release](https://github.com/endoflineservice/VoidDeck/releases/tag/v1.4.2), or press **Update now** in the Void Deck panel.
